scenes.text: After the soldiers mocked Jesus, they led him away to crucify him. They made him carry the cross on which he would die.

The soldiers brought Jesus to a place called ‘the Skull’ and nailed his hands and feet to the cross. But Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, because they do not know what they are doing.” They also put a sign on the cross above his head. It said, “King of the Jews.” This is what Pilate had told them to write.
Then the soldiers gambled for Jesus’ clothing. When they did this, they fulfilled a prophecy that said, “They divided my garments among them, and gambled for my clothing.”

There were also two robbers whom the soldiers crucified at the same time, putting them on either side of Jesus. One of the robbers mocked Jesus, but the other said to him, “Do you not fear that God will punish you? We are guilty of doing many bad things, but this man is innocent.” Then he said to Jesus, “Please remember me when you become king in your kingdom.” Jesus answered him, “Today you will be with me in Paradise.”
The Jewish leaders and the other people in the crowd mocked Jesus. They said to him, “If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross and save yourself! Then we will believe you.”
Then the sky over the whole region became completely dark, even though it was the middle of the day. It became dark at noon and stayed dark for three hours.

Then Jesus cried out, “It is finished! Father, I am giving my spirit into your hands.” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit. When he died, there was an earthquake. In the Temple, the large curtain that separated the people from the presence of God was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
Through his death, Jesus opened the way for people to come to God. When a soldier guarding Jesus saw everything that had happened, he said, “Certainly, this man was innocent. He was the Son of God.”

Then two Jewish leaders named Joseph and Nicodemus came and asked Pilate for Jesus’ body. They believed that Jesus was the Messiah. They wrapped his body in cloth, took it to a tomb cut out of rock and placed it inside. Then they rolled a large stone in front of the tomb to block the opening.

questions.question: When the soldiers led Jesus away to crucify him, what did they make him carry?
questions.answer: They made him carry the cross on which he would die.

questions.question: What was the name of the place where Jesus was crucified?
How did the soldiers attach Jesus to the cross?
questions.answer: They nailed his hands and feet to the cross.

questions.question: What did Jesus pray concerning the people who were crucifying him?
questions.answer: He prayed, “Father, forgive them, because they do not know what they are doing.”

questions.question: What was written on the sign above Jesus’ head?
questions.answer: The sign said, “King of the Jews.”

questions.question: How did the soldiers divide up Jesus’ clothes?
questions.answer: They gambled for his clothing as had been prophesied.

questions.question: What did the robber who did not mock Jesus ask him to do?
questions.answer: He asked Jesus to remember him in his kingdom.

questions.question: What was Jesus’ answer to the request of the robber?
questions.answer: Jesus said, “Today, you will be with me in Paradise.”

questions.question: What did the crowd want Jesus to do to prove that he was the Son of God?
questions.answer: They told him to come down from the cross and save himself.

questions.question: What unusual thing happened in the sky in the middle of the day?
questions.answer: It became completely dark at noon and stayed dark for three hours.

questions.question: What were the last words Jesus cried out from the cross?
questions.answer: Jesus cried out, “It is finished! Father, I give my spirit into your hands.”

questions.question: What miraculous things happened immediately after Jesus died?
questions.answer: There was an earthquake and the large curtain in the Temple was torn in two, from top to bottom.

questions.question: What did Jesus accomplish through his death?
questions.answer: Jesus opened the way for people to come to God.

questions.question: Who asked Pilate for Jesus’ body?
questions.answer: Two Jewish leaders named Joseph and Nicodemus asked for his body.

questions.question: What did they do with the body?
questions.answer: They wrapped the body in cloth and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock, and then rolled a large stone in front of the tomb.
